name: MSTN (myostatin)
summary: MSTN (myostatin), on chromosome 18, the best predictor of a Thoroughbred's best racing distance. At the variant g.66493737C>T (rs397152648, in intron 1; the position is on EquCab2.0, not EquCab3.0), C/C horses are suited to short sprints, C/T to middle distances, and T/T to longer ones, with more stamina. The effect has been traced to an insertion in the gene. Shown in Thoroughbreds; it is a statistical tendency, not a guarantee for one horse. The C allele is described as commoner in Quarter Horses and sprint-bred Thoroughbred lines and T in endurance and many European sport breeds, without published figures; performance is strongly polygenic.

phenotypes.name: Sprinter
phenotypes.description: Two C copies. Best suited to short sprint races.

phenotypes.name: Middle distance
phenotypes.description: One of each. Best suited to middle distances - the alleles do not hide each other.

phenotypes.name: Stayer
phenotypes.description: Two T copies. Best suited to longer races, with greater stamina.
